title: ever ARIA|Shimmering All Over Sequin Short Sleeves A-Line Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Dazzle in our Shimmering All Over Sequin Short Sleeves A-Line Formal Evening Dress. The entire dress is adorned with sparkling sequins, creating a mesmerizing effect. The short sleeves add a touch of sophistication to the A-line silhouette, making it a perfect choice for formal occasions. Step into the spotlight and shine with glamour in this stunning evening dress.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
